subject: Copywriting
title: One Reader at a Time
description: A micro-lesson that makes One Reader at a Time usable.

hook.text: A sales letter is read by one person, alone, in their kitchen or office. Write to that one person.

buildup.text: 'Dear valued customer' is cold. 'Dear friend' is better.

discovery.text: Use 'you' more than 'we.' The reader cares about their problems, not your company. Every sentence should be about them.

twist.text: Mass personalization—using names, locations, and behavior data—makes 'one reader' scalable.

climax.text: The letter that feels personally written to the reader outperforms everything. Intimacy beats broadcast in every test.

punchline.text: Write to one person. Use 'you' more than 'we.' Intimacy converts.

quiz.question: What word should appear most in a sales letter?
